name: mla_vectorized_kv_load
description: Use uint4 (dwordx4 = 16 bytes) vectorized loads for KV global→LDS transfer
steps: Cast KV pointer to uint4* (128-bit load)
Parallel loop: each thread loads one uint4 vector, 256 threads cover 256 vectors/iter
TOTAL_VECS = BLOCK_N × VECS_PER_ROW, threads stride by BLOCK_SIZE
Write to LDS with row padding (LDS_STRIDE = QK_HEAD_DIM + LDS_PAD)
expected_impact: Maximize HBM bandwidth utilization (near theoretical peak)
